### Wisdom from the Psalms 4/3
Author: Crosswalk.com
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/wisdom/wisdom-from-the-psalms-4-or-3-552244.html
Passage: Psalm 35:1
Points:
- Facing trials alone quickly drains personal strength and resolve.
- God designed people to need companions who support and confirm one another.
- The Lord actively contends on behalf of His followers in their struggles.
- Believers can take comfort knowing God never leaves them to fight alone.
